summary: The registrant, Banco Latinoamericano de Comercio Exterior, S.A. (Bladex), filed a Form 6-K to announce the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. This is a routine reporting obligation of a foreign private issuer with the SEC. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is involved. The filing indicates no deal terms, no board recommendation or advisor, and no structural mechanics. This is purely an annual disclosure, not a special situation warranting any other category.
